# Define the decision variables
# x[i][j] = 1 if Good i is allocated to Person j, 0 otherwise
x = [[pulp.LpVariable(f"x_{i}_{j}", cat="Binary") for j in range(1, 4)] for i in range(1, 4)]

# y[j] represents the amount of money allocated to Person j
y = [pulp.LpVariable(f"y_{j}", lowBound=0, upBound=5) for j in range(1, 4)]

    for i, good in enumerate(goods):
        person = allocation[i]
        if person:  # Check if the good is allocated
            total_value += persons[person][good]
    values[allocation] = total_value

# Find the allocation with the maximum total value
best_allocation = max(values, key=values.get)

# Allocate the money proportionally to the valuations of the remaining goods

    for i, good in enumerate(goods):

            money_allocation[person] += persons[person][good] / total_valuation * remaining_value

# Print the allocation

    print(f"{good}: {best_allocation[i]}")
